data.why: Walmart's agreement to add 300 drone delivery sites is less than a week old and represents massive operational scale. Building out 300 physical sites drives immediate procurement and purchase requisition volume.
data.angle: Scaling 300 new operational sites creates a massive surge in site purchase orders, contractor setup, and procurement approvals.

Bad news: headline discusses a competitor's stock cratering 69%.
The $1.5B Series I funding round was covered by dozens of outlets; opening with the Walmart 300-site operational expansion is much more specific to finance back-office load.
Sendil has been CFO for over four months (133 days), making it stale compared to news from this week.

data.subject: 300 drone delivery sites
data.body:
Hi Sendil,

Walmart and Zipline reached an agreement to add 300 drone delivery sites.

Rolling out that many new locations usually brings a huge flood of purchase orders, site contractor bills, and supplier approvals. Who is handling all those requisitions today?

Amgen automated 85% of purchase requisitions through approval with Zamp.

Worth a look as you scale the network?

[Your name]
